'''Baroo Coast''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. It was the sixth race in the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]] tournament, and [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]] was considered the track favorite.
